group: Validators Initialization - read returns null (NullPointerException from Collections.unmodifiableList)

cases.description: When the private read(JsonNode) method returns null, Collections.unmodifiableList(null) throws a NullPointerException. The exception must propagate out of getValidators() and the internal validators field must remain null.
If getSchemaNode() (inherited from BaseJsonValidator) throws a RuntimeException while getValidators() is executing, the exception should bubble up unchanged and the validators field must stay null.

When the private read(JsonNode) method throws an IllegalArgumentException (e.g., due to an illegal schema definition), getValidators() must not catch it; the exception propagates to the caller and the validators cache remains uninitialized.

If the private read(JsonNode) method throws a NullPointerException (for example, because the supplied schema node is null), getValidators() should let the exception propagate and leave the validators field as null.
